name: Authored public-atlas retrieval sanity set, revision 1
authorship: Mathematics audit agent, after inspecting atlas node labels, summaries and prerequisite edges, before running either retrieval comparison.
scoring: Answerable success means at least one predeclared acceptable ID occurs in the first six returned records. Absent-answer success requires zero returned records. These acceptable sets are not exhaustive relevance judgments.

questions.question: Which dependencies must a result cache key include when source evidence or scope policy changes?
questions.rationale: These records state result reuse dependencies, invalidation, and the dependency-key formula.

questions.question: Why does time-to-live fail to detect revoked scope or a changed source?
questions.rationale: These records distinguish TTL from source/version and authorization checks.

questions.question: What is the attention key-value cache, and how is it different from an editable evidence graph?
questions.rationale: The KV-cache concept explicitly distinguishes inference tensors from an evidence graph.

questions.question: When should a research improvement loop stop instead of repeatedly searching?
questions.rationale: These nodes cover acceptance bounds, observed improvement, and avoiding repetition as a proxy for progress.

questions.question: Which concept comes before Fourier transforms in the prerequisite graph?
questions.rationale: The inspected prerequisite edge is m-complex prerequisite_of m-fourier. This is an intentionally relational question rather than an exact-label lookup.

questions.question: Before personalized PageRank, what should I know about random walk transitions and fixed points?
questions.rationale: Both inspected nodes have direct prerequisite_of edges into g-pagerank.

questions.question: Give the personalized PageRank recurrence with restart and its convergence or residual error bound.
questions.rationale: These formula nodes provide the recurrence or its explicitly requested convergence/error component.

questions.question: How does Bayes rule update dependent evidence without assuming conditional independence?
questions.rationale: The formula derivation explicitly retains conditioning on the previous evidence.

questions.question: Why can nonoverlapping Allan variance be zero for a clock with constant frequency bias?
questions.rationale: The formula record includes the constant-bias counterexample and stability/accuracy distinction.

questions.question: How does the graph Laplacian pseudoinverse give effective electrical resistance from injected unit current?
questions.rationale: The worked derivation explicitly connects graph linear algebra and current/voltage interpretation.

questions.question: When can graph eigenvalues become physical frequencies, and what dynamics and units are needed?
questions.rationale: The bridge and graph-wave formula require a dynamical interpretation rather than equating eigenvalues with physical frequencies automatically.

questions.question: How do magnetic spin models relate to associative memory without making software weights measured magnetic couplings?
questions.rationale: These records identify the mathematical analogy and its model/physical-unit boundary.

questions.question: Who approved the private payroll budget for the invented company Aster Quay on 17 November 2026?
questions.rationale: No such company approval or private payroll record exists in the public atlas. Shared words may still attract non-answering records; that counts as a failed abstention control.

questions.question: zibberflume thraxomite quuxphenion
questions.rationale: An explicit out-of-vocabulary lexical control with no intended answer or concept in the atlas.
